Name: Hillier Hill-Top
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
- features -

[list]
[*]all grass is tillable
[*]lots of berry bushes
[*]quarry (replaces hill-top farm by default)
[*]two separate warp links for fast travel around the farm
[*]waterfalls and seasonal decorations
[/list]

- credits -

[list]
[*]flower sprites: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891]eemiestardew[/url]﻿
[*]waterfalls: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/waterfall-tilesheet-w-animation.132102/page-2]maleha & voltaic123[/url]﻿
[*]willow tree: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/ruevian.627414/]ruevian[/url]
[/list] ﻿﻿(all included)


- installation -

[list]
[*]install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿
[*]unzip mod folder into [code]stardew valley/mods[/code]
[*]run game with smapi
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Hillier Hill-Top
Manifest.Description: a hill-top farm map with more of a multilevel mountainside vibe
Manifest.Author: DaisyNiko
